title: Drying Equipment Daily Rate Card for Water Damage Mitigation Tiers
content:
Water Damage Mitigation drying equipment is rented to the job per unit per billable day at the daily rate of the job's tier for that equipment type. This rate card lists every equipment rate and the air scrubber requirement for each of the six tiers.

| Tier | Air mover | LGR dehumidifier | XL LGR dehumidifier | Desiccant dehumidifier |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Clean Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $28.50 | $95.40 | $122.75 | $286.00 |
| Clean Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $25.65 | $85.86 | $110.48 | $257.40 |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $28.50 | $95.40 | $122.75 | $286.00 |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $25.65 | $85.86 | $110.48 | $257.40 |
| Black Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $28.50 | $95.40 | $122.75 | $286.00 |
| Black Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $25.65 | $85.86 | $110.48 | $257.40 |

| Tier | HEPA air scrubber | Drying mat system | Heat drying unit | Air scrubber required |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Clean Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $78.60 | $112.00 | $165.00 | No |
| Clean Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $70.74 | $100.80 | $148.50 | No |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $78.60 | $112.00 | $165.00 | No |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $70.74 | $100.80 | $148.50 | Yes |
| Black Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $78.60 | $112.00 | $165.00 | Yes |
| Black Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $70.74 | $100.80 | $148.50 | Yes |

All rates are USD per unit (per setup for the drying mat system) per billable day.

## Rate card definitions
- **Air mover**: Air mover rental per unit per billable day, USD.
- **LGR dehumidifier**: LGR dehumidifier (standard) per unit per billable day, USD.
- **XL LGR dehumidifier**: Large-capacity (XL) LGR dehumidifier per unit per billable day, USD.
- **Desiccant dehumidifier**: Desiccant dehumidifier per unit per billable day, USD.
- **HEPA air scrubber**: HEPA air scrubber / negative air machine per unit per billable day, USD.
- **Drying mat system**: Wall or floor cavity drying mat / injection system per setup per billable day, USD.
- **Heat drying unit**: Indirect-fired heat drying unit per unit per billable day, USD.
- **Air scrubber required**: Whether a HEPA air scrubber must run for the whole drying period, boolean.

## Notes on the card
- Both Standard Loss tiers and both Large Loss tiers of a water category share one equipment price level per size: every Standard Loss tier carries the same equipment rates, and every Large Loss tier carries the same, lower, equipment rates.
- The air scrubber requirement is set on Gray Water Mitigation - Large Loss and on both Black Water Mitigation tiers, and is not set on the two Clean Water Mitigation tiers or on Gray Water Mitigation - Standard Loss.
